title: Lānaʻi minor SMA permit rule change
summary: In August 2026 staff said a rule change for minor special management area permits should be finished by the next month and takes effect within 10 business days after the clerk receives it. In September staff said the commission did not need a formal vote on a Four Seasons luau grounds event permit because the rule change was not yet official.
